faq.q: Do I need the base game for Brotato Primal Dread?
faq.a: Yes. Steam lists the base game as required, so install the DLC under the same account that owns Brotato, then check Item Sets.

faq.q: Is Primal Dread coming to console and mobile?
faq.a: The publisher briefing checked on 18 November 2026 gives early 2027 for console and mobile, with no exact day.

faq.q: Should I pick Mecha or Mutation?
faq.a: Choose Mecha when a weapon core carries the run and Mutation when a passive item package does. Both change enemy hazards.

faq.q: Can I play Brotato co-op with friends online?
faq.a: Steam lists local co-op and Remote Play Together, where one host runs the game and invites guests.

faq.q: Do Workshop mods still work after update 1.2?
faq.a: Outdated mods can conflict. Reproduce the crash with mods off first, then restore compatible ones one at a time.
